text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of this year's Arima Kinen 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who took the Tiara route by 
storm! It's Mejiro Ramonu!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In this Arima Kinen, gathered with titans 
of the turf! Letting no one close! She has 
bloomed into a magnificent flower--!!

Lack of experience, distance anxiety... 
Defying every disadvantage and staying 
true to her own running— she brilliantly 
claimed victory in the Arima Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Ramonu has just looked toward the 
stands! Could that gaze be directed at... 
her Trainer? They were cheering for her 
exceptionally loudly!"

Mejiro Ramonu whispered something to me. 
Amid the roaring cheers, I couldn't hear 
her words—

So after the race ended, when I asked once 
again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well now. Why don't you try and guess?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "And why would I tell you that?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If you do not understand, pray think upon 
it more carefully."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Keep tracing those lips from that moment.
